source.snippet: Any small web agencies out there? How do you track everything when it comes to long term project management, especially on customers with retainers? We're a small agency that look after a number of clients and about 150 websites for them, a mix of Wordpress and non-wordpress sites and systems. I've tried things like Monday and such, but they are all too 'generic' I find, especially when it comes to retainer tracking and per-client task visibility.

problem_statement: Small web agencies managing large client portfolios (50–200+ sites, many on retainers) cannot find project management software that handles per-client retainer tracking, site-specific task queues, and multi-client visibility — generic tools like Monday.com are too broad and create overhead rather than reducing it.
target_segment: Small web agencies (2–20 person teams) managing retainer clients across mixed CMS environments (WordPress and custom), typically 50–200 client sites.
notes: Poster is actively paying for Monday.com and similar tools but finds them inadequate — clear existing spend with dissatisfaction. Web agencies managing 150 sites on retainer are a well-defined, recurring-revenue buyer segment. Opportunity for a vertical PM tool or lightweight SaaS specifically for web agency retainer workflows. Multiple threads across freelancing and PM forums corroborate this gap.
